function wrap<W extends {}, T extends W & {}>(value: T, witness: W): {value: T} { return {value}; }
function wrapIndexed<W extends {name: {}}, T extends W['name']>(
  value: T, witness: W
): {value: T} { return {value}; }
const witness: {} = 'broad';
const direct = wrap('actual', witness);
const indexed = wrapIndexed('other', {name: witness});
const first: 'actual' = direct.value;
const second: 'other' = indexed.value;
